column1: # tests/ci_cadence.tsv — THE CADENCE of each static-tier gate (14z-162, GitHub #148,
# A gate NOT listed here is `session` cadence: it runs on every invocation. A
# listed gate runs only when the invocation's cadence is at least its own
# (`--cadence session|freeze|release`, default session), OR when a path it
# depends on has changed (its TRIGGERS, below, plus its own tests/<gate>.sh —
# always) since origin/main or in the working tree. Deferred gates are NAMED in
# the readout, never silently dropped, and a freeze or a release ALWAYS runs the
# full tier on the commit it builds from (`--cadence freeze` / `--cadence
# release`), which is the safety net that makes session-cadence deferral safe.
# The ruling (2026-09-17, on the 14z-162 measurement — the top seven gates were
# ~11 of the tier's 20 minutes, every one re-proving a build/content invariant
# that only moves at a freeze): those seven -> freeze with path triggers; the
# release and MiSTer gates -> release; everything else stays session. SECOND CUT
# release_os_metadata, mister_page — a docs-consistency check) BACK to session:
# deferring them saves nothing and the docs check "has likely always value";
# and the five 35-39 s gates (suite_dispatch_selftest, reconcile_matcher,
# frozen_rompath_guard, accent_census, emulator_runner) -> freeze, each with the
# small file set whose property it locks as its triggers (~3 min per session run).
# THIRD CUT (maintainer, 2026-10-06, 14z-193 — "freeze cadence"): test_freeze_bytediff (~85 s, eight romsets
# decrypted) -> freeze; its triggers include tests/expected/registry.tsv, so the commit that adds a freeze's rows
# runs it in a session tier too.
# A new listing is a reviewed event: it moves a gate OUT of every session run.
# FOURTH CUT (maintainer, 2026-10-09, 14z-196 — bbh is its own project now, "should not be a target or what we do in
# vampire saved"; asked how to treat its fidelity gate: "Drop now, and move test_bbh_fidelity out of the static tier
# until settled"): cadence `ondemand` — deferred and named at every cadence, freeze and release included, never pulled
# back by a changed path; it runs only with --cadence ondemand or sh tests/<gate>.sh. Triggers `-`.
# test_bbh_fidelity DELETED (maintainer, 2026-10-10, 14z-197: *"yest delete it"*): it compared this tree's runners with
# bbh's, no longer a constraint. The `ondemand` cadence stays, with no member.
# FIFTH CUT (14z-199, #268 — on the maintainer's C1 ruling, DECISIONS_HISTORY.md "Ruled 2026-10-12 (14z-199)": "I agree
# with your proposals for C1, C2, C3, C4" and "maybe we could limit what we need to check, for instance parts/paperwork
# we didn't touch would not need checking"; the FREEZE cadence, the session's application of the same entry's turned-
# around tier, the maintainer then validated — DECISIONS_HISTORY.md "Ruled 2026-10-13 (14z-199)": "Points 1 and 2 I
# validated"): test_retraction_reach — every retraction file on one scan of the whole tree, split out
# of test_close_tools, which ran one scan per file at every session (565 s) — -> freeze, triggered by the matcher only:
# a new tests/rulecheck/retractions/{KEY}.tsv is judged on the whole tree by the close's own standing check, and every
# file's gone wordings on the touched files by test_close_tools, so the directory is not a trigger.

column1: # SIXTH CUT (maintainer, 2026-10-18, 14z-205, GitHub #297 — asked which families "would have very little impact being
# run only at freeze/release", then "Let's do all three"; asked when a session should still run one: "Own code changed
# (Recommended)"): the 109 session gates of six families -> freeze, triggered by `@code` only. Measured on the record
# of 104 static runs (2026-10-02..18, build/agent205/tier_history_filtered.log, local): pipeline 43 gates 3 session
# reds, review-triage 31 gates 1, gfx 13, oracle 10, mister 7, tenant 5 gates 0; in the two 14z-205 closes they re-ran
# 71 and 66 times for 319 s each. `@code` (tests/run_all_static.sh cad_triggers, tools/static_confirm.py `reach`)
# is every program of the gate's own reach, so a session that edits a gate or the code it runs still runs it, and a
# change to what it checks (a manifest, a data file) waits for the freeze, which runs everything.
# SEVENTH CUT (maintainer, 2026-10-23, 14z-206, #291 — "Of note: if we have any tests/gates on the captures sheets, they really should be ondemand scope"): the gates whose subject is the comparative
# capture sheets themselves go ondemand. Of the static tier that is test_sheet_census (every emulator gate declares its
# `# SHEET:` or is on the debt list); its emulator-tier twin test_proof_sheets moves to scope `ondemand` in
# tests/ci_emulator.tsv (reason `sheets:`). A gate that only DRAWS a sheet when SHEET_OUT is set is not a sheet gate and
# keeps its cadence. They run with --cadence ondemand (test_sheet_census), tests/run_all_emulator.sh --scope ondemand
# #338 (14z-213): the proof sheets' web build (tools/proof_sheets.py web/webcheck) is a gate on the capture sheets, so it
# goes ondemand under the same ruling.
# #316 (14z-208): the release-reuse gate drives both runners and the identity tool over a synthetic repo (~12 s, seven
# controls of ~12 s each) -> freeze, triggered by what it runs: the two runners, the tool and its import, the libraries.
